headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: Positives: • Blended realizations at Rs4,981/ton (+1.2% yoy, +1.1% qoq) saw qoq improvement on better trade prices in south region. • EBITDA for the quarter was flat qoq at Rs660/ton (7.2% above our estimate) in contrast to peers, which saw a qoq decline of ~Rs180/ton in our coverage universe.

Negatives: • Costs at Rs4,321/ton (+6.2% yoy, +1.4% qoq) were marginally higher than estimates on operating deleverage and higher raw material-energy costs. • We expect cost impact to outpace price hikes in the near term.
